claim_ceiling: Cluster-conformal field-coverage evaluator and first-order field-functional uncertainty reference. No raw PIV processing, empirical calibration, EHD force measurement or thrust validation is claimed.

conformal_contract.vector_score: e^T Sigma^-1 e, squared Mahalanobis residual
conformal_contract.cluster_score: maximum squared Mahalanobis score over every vector in the field and all four physical regions
conformal_contract.field_size_policy: exact vector count per calibration and target field
assumptions: calibration field clusters and future field cluster exchangeable
same frozen acquisition, geometry, grid, masks, processing and field size
independent or exchangeable cluster-level units; no hidden shared acquisition cause
conformal_contract.guarantee: finite-sample marginal coverage of every scored vector in one future field with probability >= 1-alpha over calibration and target fields, conditional on the stated cluster exchangeability design
non_guarantees: not conditional on the fixed observed calibration sample
not robust to unaccounted distribution shift
protocol fingerprint does not prove exchangeability
temporal dependence between clusters is not corrected
changed number of vectors or region masks invalidates the same max-score calibration

related_methods.name: Distribution-Free Prediction Sets for Two-Layer Hierarchical Models
related_methods.role: hierarchical new-group conformal; CDF pooling and single/repeated subsampling; benchmark separately because prediction estimand differs
grouped-validation / equal-cluster calibration analog on clustered panel data, not a PIV method
effective-sample-size analysis under shared-ancestry clusters; adjacent theoretical motivation only

functional_contract.covariance_model: blockdiag(local covariance) + sum(shared mode sensitivity outer product)
functional_contract.output: 4x4 covariance over mass and three momentum-flux components including cross-covariance
assumptions: local velocity errors independent across samples
cross-location dependence represented by declared shared modes
shared modes independent after supplied factorization
all local covariance matrices positive semidefinite

dimension_compatibility.rule: A planar 2D conformal radius cannot validate an out-of-plane component. The 3D conformal scorer is dimension-compatible with the 3D field functional only when protocol fingerprint, field size and covariance model are identical.

functional_references: Monte Carlo with frozen covariance factors
existing EHD control-volume reducer and direct force balance

prospective_targets.monte_carlo_comparison: report confidence intervals and convergence, not a single point tolerance

conformal_3d_contract.cluster_score: maximum vector score across all four regions
conformal_3d_contract.compatibility: Dimension-matched to the 3D functional covariance model when the same frozen protocol, field size and full three-component predictive covariance are used.

integrated_functional_conformal_contract.reference: independent traceable reference functional values with unique evidence identities
integrated_functional_conformal_contract.score: 4D squared Mahalanobis residual, using covariance normalized to correlation matrix before Cholesky
integrated_functional_conformal_contract.cluster_score: maximum score across all functional observations in one independent laboratory session
